parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file is a set of HTTP request-parsing helpers in the infrastructure layer. It turns untyped request bodies and query values into strings. The only validation it does is check the type of each value ("is it a string"), which is transport-level input checking and fits an HTTP adapter. It has no domain invariants or business rules, and it does no persistence or orchestration. When the input has the wrong shape, it throws an ApplicationError with the "validation" category. That reports the failure in the application's error vocabulary; it doesn't add business logic. The import direction itself is out of scope here. Every responsibility in the file belongs to the infrastructure (transport) role.
